title: Mull It Over
description: Parse corrupted memory for mul() instructions with conditional toggles.
writeup:
## Approach

The input is a stream of corrupted text containing valid `mul(X,Y)` instructions mixed with garbage. A single regex finds all three instruction types: `mul(X,Y)`, `do()`, and `don't()`.

## Part 1

Sum the products of all `mul(X,Y)` instructions, ignoring everything else.

## Part 2

`do()` and `don't()` act as toggles enabling/disabling subsequent `mul` instructions. Process tokens left-to-right, tracking the enabled state. Only add products when multiplications are enabled.
